method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a layer beside baseline-2026-10 (Chapter 4A), which is untouched; duties with deadlines are regulative rules run inside the questions (CONSIDER EVALTRACE ... WHEN FULFILLED); no exported question takes a DEONTIC or EVENT input; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 89 (register id C2025C00525), compilation date 5 September 2025, includes amendments up to Act No. 38, 2025; retrieved 13 October 2026; Chapter 4 in force from 4 October 2002 (No. 24, 2002, sch 1), today's text applied to every date since (NOTES.md finding 11); Therapeutic Goods (Medical Devices) Regulations 2002 not deposited (essential principles, reporting periods, reportable and exempt devices are inputs); Acts Interpretation Act 1901 s 36(1) item 6 and s 36(2) (Saturdays and Sundays only) from subjects/au/acts-interpretation-act-1901

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tga-devices.l4 ; l4 run tga-cases-devices.l4

scope: Chapter 4 medical devices as the patient meets them: s 3(1) (sponsor, supply (d), healthcare facility, reportable medical device, exempt device), ss 41BD, 41BF, 41BG, 41FM, 41FN(3)(d), 41GI, 41GQ (dates asked), 41HC(6B), (6E), (6F), (6FA), 41JM, 41KA, 41KC, 41KCA, 41MA(5), (8), (8A), (8B), 41MAA(2), 41MB, 41MI(1), (4)-(7), 41MIB, 41MP, 41MPA, with ss 41MPB, 41GN(1)(d), 41KE as they bear on these. Out: import and export limbs, conformity assessment and Register application machinery, suspension and cancellation grounds and procedure, conditions, false statements, advertising, special and experimental use offences, s 41MK, ss 41MQ, 41MR, 41JA-41JJ, 61, 54B, 54BA, fees
focus: devices: pelvic mesh, implants (claims work: medical negligence and product liability, class actions)
seat: the patient who has had a medical device implanted or used in their treatment and has been harmed by it
questions_exported: Is my implant a medical device
Is this company the sponsor of my device
Is this company the manufacturer of my device
Was my device covered when it was supplied to me
What does the supplier face for supplying my device uncovered
What does the supplier face for supplying my device non-compliant
Can the sponsor be required to recall or warn about my device
Can the supplier be required to recall or warn about my device
Does a recall requirement reach my device
What does a person face for not complying with a recall or warning requirement
Was it information the sponsor had to report
Did the sponsor report in time
What does the sponsor face for not reporting
Must the hospital report what happened to me
Was the supply to me notified in time
regulative_rules: ss 41MP, 41MPA -- the sponsor must give the information to the Secretary within the period in the regulations
s 41HC(6B) -- the health practitioner must notify the supply within 28 days after it
